intent: Split the largest linux_configuration script under the cap, and defer a second whose every function writes to one shared array.
scope: lib/nc_image.sh, nc_flash.sh, nc_remote.sh, nc_remote_flash.sh, nc_packages.sh, nc_services.sh, nc_php.sh, nc_discover.sh (new)
changes: setup_nextcloud_raspberry.sh split five ways in one pass, then three of those libs were carved again - the first pass left nc_image, nc_remote and nc_services at 272, 292 and 277 lines. Eight libs from one 1383-line script.

Fixed three unguarded cd /var/www/nextcloud calls, each immediately before an `occ` command. A failed cd would have run the Nextcloud installer or the cron switch against whatever directory the caller was in. Third script in this effort to have this bug.

check_and_enable_services.sh was split four ways and then fully reverted. SERVICE_STATUS is declared once and written by every check_* function, so any lib holding those functions fails SC2034 when linted alone. This is the fourth file deferred for shared state, and the clearest: the script IS an accumulator, so there is no seam anywhere in it.

verification.evidence: First run reported SC2164 for the unguarded cd calls; after guarding them, 'libs sourced, functions defined' across all eight libs.
Clean, with no disable directive. Each lib is checked in isolation, which is what the pre-commit hook does.

verification.command: git checkout HEAD -- check_and_enable_services.sh, rm its svc_*.sh libs, ls the lib dir
verification.evidence: Restored to 1337 lines and shellcheck -x clean. The directory still contains periodic_browser.sh from an earlier commit - confirmed by listing it rather than assuming the revert removed only what it should.
setup_nextcloud_raspberry.sh and all eight libs are under the cap; the largest is 182 lines.

risks: Not executed: it flashes SD cards, installs packages over SSH to a Raspberry Pi, and configures MariaDB, PHP and Apache. The cd guards change the failure path - previously the installer would have run in the wrong directory, now it returns 1 - which is the intended correction but is a behaviour change.

check_and_enable_services.sh stays at 1337 lines, now the largest file in the repo. Splitting it means giving each check_* function a return value instead of writing to SERVICE_STATUS, which is a genuine refactor of the script's whole design.
rollback: git revert the commit; setup_nextcloud_raspberry.sh returns to 1383 lines and the eight libs disappear.
After rollback, re-run bash -n and shellcheck on the restored script.
